links.comparator_used: Neutral prompt with no assigned role or persona
links.outcome: Physiotherapist-rated response quality (relevance, accuracy, comprehensiveness, clarity; 5-point rubric) for 21 pelvic floor physiotherapy questions
links.effect: Significant improvement across all domains (p < 0.001); mean differences: comprehensiveness 1.45, relevance 1.12, accuracy 0.88, clarity 1.48; Cohen's d 1.66-2.11; inter-rater ICC 0.61-0.81
links.tradeoff: Accuracy remains imperfect, so all generated responses still require careful professional oversight.
links.quote: Persona-based prompting significantly improved response quality across all domains (p < 0.001).
